segments.contextAfter: Setting down Logitech Muse outside of Vision Pro’s field of view might cause Vision Pro to no longer receive pinch inputs from the hand that had been holding Muse.  (160816595) **Workaround:** Pick Muse back up and set it down within Vision Pro’s field of view.
